articleTitle: Will Preschool Help My 3-Year-Old's Aggression After a New Baby?
imageHeadline: Preschool won't fix sibling aggression alone
imageSubtext: The behavior is about your relationship—that's where the repair happens
pinTitle: Will Preschool Help My 3-Year-Old's Aggression After a New Baby? What Actually Works
pinDescription: Your preschooler's hitting and attention-seeking since the baby arrived makes sense—but preschool alone won't resolve it. The aggression is her way of asking if she still matters to you. Learn what research shows about sibling adjustment and the specific strategies that help more than waiting it out.

items.label: Teach and reinforce the behavior you want
Follow through when she asks without aggression
